videoUrl.title: YouTube video URL
videoUrl.description: Supports watch?v=, youtu.be/, and shorts/ URL formats

preferredLanguage.title: Preferred transcript languages (ordered)
preferredLanguage.description: Language codes in order of preference, e.g. ["en", "en-US"]. Falls back to default track if none found.

removeBrackets.title: Remove non-speech markers
removeBrackets.description: Remove well-known bracketed markers such as [Music] and [Applause] from the transcript.

outputMode.title: Output mode
outputMode.description: text_only returns the full transcript string. text_and_segments also includes per-segment timing data.

proxyMode.title: Proxy mode
proxyMode.description: auto tries datacenter then residential. Requires Apify proxy credentials.

maxRetries.title: Max retries per proxy mode
maxRetries.description: Number of retry attempts after the first try (per proxy mode). 0 = no retries.

timeoutMs.title: Per-request timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.description: Timeout applied to each yt-dlp subprocess call, in milliseconds.

timeoutSecs.title: Per-request timeout (seconds, optional)
timeoutSecs.description: Alternative to timeoutMs. Ignored if timeoutMs is also set.

saveVttToKV.title: Save raw VTT to Key-Value Store
saveVttToKV.description: When enabled, the raw .vtt subtitle file is stored in the default Key-Value Store.

debug.title: Debug logging
debug.description: Enable verbose debug output. Proxy credentials are always redacted from logs.
